'''Bald-Wampa Is this a good deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bald-Wampa]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Security Tower|CC-D-cloudcitysecuritytower.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Security Tower
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Cloud City Security Tower Bald-W Isthisag.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My friend made this deck for me, and im a total newb. Is this a good deck? He says this deck could own even the bestest players. Is it true????

The published list has 58 cards.
